θεάομαι.shortDefinition: to witness, behold, look closely, watch intently

θλίβω.shortDefinition: to press, constrict; fig. to oppress, afflict

θλῖψις.shortDefinition: a pressure, constriction; fig. an oppression, affliction

θνητός.shortDefinition: to be able to die, mortal

θύω.shortDefinition: to rush; fig. to slaughter, sacrifice (by fire)
